name: Horom
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: Only wordlists (Blench, Nettle); archived Blench Horom PDFs checked, image scans, no stress statement; rogerblench.info domain now squatted.

sources.citation: Blench, Roger. 2010 [printout dated 29 Aug 2010; Glottolog lists as 2012]. The Horom language of Central Nigeria and its affinities. Draft circulated for comment. Cambridge: Kay Williamson Educational Foundation. 25 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Section 3 'Phonology' (p.2) covers vowels (7), consonants and 3.3 Tones: 'The tone system of Horom is quite restricted, with only two tones. The majority of words appear all low tone. No cases of glide tones seem to occur. In most cases the tone is left unmarked.' No mention of stress/accent anywhere in the 25 pp. (text layer present; a full-text search for stress/accent|accent|penult|prominen = 0 hits). Bytes identical to the Internet Archive 2020 and 2024 captures of rogerblench.info Horom.

sources.citation: Blench, Roger. 1999. Field trip 1998-9 report on Plateau languages (held); Blench Fyem and Rukul wordlists (same folder).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Only one passing mention of Horom (as a non-Kulere village); no stress/accent statements in any of the three sibling files (a full-text search for stress/accent found nothing).
